title: Youth For Christ
desc: Pastor Chris starts Youth For Christ at Ambrose Alli University (Bendel State) — a campus fellowship raised by the Word that becomes Believers' LoveWorld.

title: Christ Embassy, Lagos
desc: Fellowship becomes Christ Embassy, headquartered at 8 Billings Way, Oregun, Ikeja, Lagos — now 145+ branches across 5 continents, taking the divine presence to nations.

title: LoveWorld Nation
desc: Launch of LoveWorldSAT (first 24/7 Christian TV from Africa), Rhapsody of Realities in 8,300+ languages, Healing School, InnerCity Mission — giving lives a meaning in 100+ nations. Glory to God!

title: PH Zone 3 → Philippines
desc: Zone 3 adopts the Philippines for Rhapsody missions — plants Christ Embassy Makati and delegates attend the International Cell Leaders' Conference (ICLC).

title: PH Zone 3 Growth
desc: Zone pioneers 6 churches, 225 outreaches, 410 cells — CC1 emerges fastest-growing Category 5 church in the Zone.

title: CC3 Group
desc: Christ Embassy Central Church 3 (Group Headquarters) at 30B Rumuokwuta/NTA Road — pastored by Pastor Kelson Onoriode, the only Pastor at the Group Church — serves the Group family of 6 churches across Rumuokwuta, Orazi, GRA, Trans-Amadi and beyond, with 28+ cells, Foundation School and vibrant departments. Blessed be God!
